import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/guildSecretRealmWar/challenge/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const text = (e.MessageText || '').trim();
  const m = text.match(/^[!！/#＃]?灵脉攻防战挑战\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*$/);

  if (!m) {
    return;
  }
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const result = await App({ bid, uid: Number(e.uid), realmNo: Number(m[1]), positionNo: Number(m[2]), request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    md.addText(result.data.message);
  } else {
    const r = result.data;

    md.addText(r.won ? '挑战胜利，已占领该位置。' : '挑战失败。');
    if (r.participationContribution > 0) {
      md.addNewline().addText(`本周首次有效占领：贡献 +${r.participationContribution}（已到账）`);
    }
    if (typeof r.frozenUntil === 'string') {
      md.addNewline().addText(`冻结至：${r.frozenUntil}`);
    }
  }
  void message.send(
    FormatGui({ isPrivate: e.isPrivate ?? false, bid, title: '灵脉攻防战 - 挑战', content: md, footer: [{ label: '返回', command: '/灵脉攻防战' }] })
  );
});
